newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso ends firm on move into Cetes.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso ends firm on move into Cetes.

text.p: Mexico's same-day peso closed 2.3 centavos firmer at 7.5220/7.5250 per dollar on Tuesday as local and foreign investors bought pesos to invest in the money market, traders said.
"Some foreigners and quite a few local brokers have sold short (dollar) positions to switch to Cetes," a trader said.
Short-term Cetes were expected to gain 25 basis points at this evening's auction.

"There is still interest in Cetes," a trader said. He added that 28-day and 91-day rates would not likely gain much, but long-term issues could fall a good bit deal as inflation expectations for next year are lower. Traders had no clear idea of what maturity would draw most interest in today's auction.
The 48-hour and 24-hour peso were meanwhile one and 0.9 of a centavo firmer, respectively, at 7.5290/7.5310 and 7.5240/7.5290 per dollar.
Traders said the 48-hour peso was testing resistance at 7.53 per dollar.
